= Source substitutions
:source-highlighter: rouge
:project-name: acdc

.Default source substitutions
[source,rust]
----
let value = "{project-name}"; // (C) ... -> *bold* <1>
----
<1> Default callout.

.Attributes added
[source,rust,subs="+attributes"]
----
let value = "{project-name}";
----

.Replacements added
[source,rust,subs="+replacements"]
----
// (C) ... -> --
----

.Callouts removed
[source,rust,subs="-callouts"]
----
let value = 1; // <1>
----

.No substitutions
[source,rust,subs=none]
----
let value = "{project-name}"; // (C) ... -> *bold*
----

.Explicit substitution set
[source,rust,subs="specialcharacters,attributes,replacements,callouts"]
----
let value = "{project-name}"; // (C) ... -> *bold* <1>
----
<1> Explicit callout.
